name: Graphite India Ltd
about: Graphite India Ltd is mainly engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling of graphite & carbon and other products.[1]
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 50.4%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 88.2 days to 62.4 days
cons: Stock is trading at 2.57 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.81% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.14% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.317 Cr.
